allowInitializePath((uint32,bytes32,uint.details: This indicates to the endpoint that the OApp has enabled msgs for this particular path to be received.This defaults to assuming if a peer has been set, its initialized. Can be overridden by the OApp if there is other logic to determine this.

params.origin: The origin information containing the source endpoint and sender address.

returns._0: Whether the path has been initialized.

params.delegate: Address that MUST be the contract owner; it is set as both Ownable owner and LayerZero delegate.
params.hubEid_: LayerZero endpoint ID of the Hub contract.
params.singleWithdrawGlobalVerifier_: Groth16 verifier for global single teleports.
params.singleWithdrawLocalVerifier_: Groth16 verifier for local single teleports.
params.token_: zERC20 token whose hash chain is reserved/minted against.
params.withdrawGlobalDecider_: Nova verifier for global teleport proofs.
params.withdrawLocalDecider_: Nova verifier for local teleport proofs.

isComposeMsgSender((uint32,bytes32,uint6.details: _origin The origin information containing the source endpoint and sender address.  - srcEid: The source chain endpoint ID.  - sender: The sender address on the src chain.  - nonce: The nonce of the message._message The lzReceive payload.Applications can optionally choose to implement separate composeMsg senders that are NOT the bridging layer.The default sender IS the OAppReceiver implementer.

lzReceive((uint32,bytes32,uint64),bytes3.details: Entry point for receiving messages or packets from the endpoint.Entry point for receiving msg/packet from the LayerZero endpoint.

params._executor: The address of the executor for the received message.
params._extraData: Additional arbitrary data provided by the corresponding executor.
params._guid: The unique identifier for the received LayerZero message.
params._message: The payload of the received message.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.
